notes.title: STICK ENGINE v1.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Engineers,

A couple new features, a couple bugs fixed.

[b]New in 1.0.3[/b]
[list]
    [*]You can now change between XBOX and PlayStation controller prompts
[*]You can now pan in the editor by holding spacebar and click-dragging with any mouse button
[*]You can now pan in the editor using the arrow keys
[*]You can now set your adventure cart to unlock levels in sequential order

[/list]

[b]Fixes in 1.0.3[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed an error where shuriken guy wouldn't throw his shuriken
    [*]Fixed some menu-related crashes
[/list]
As always, enjoy!

-Troy

notes.title: STICK ENGINE v1.0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Engineers,

A big thanks to those reporting bugs, we're working night and day to get these issues resolved so we can get to work on new features!

[b]Fixes in 1.0.2[/b]
[list]
    [*]Fixed an error where multiple inputs could cause a problem with the gun
 [*]Cartridge names in the download cartridge menu no longer extend past their boxes
 [*]An error caused by a workshop download completing mid-game has been fixed
 [*]Screen shake has been adjusted for a slightly more mild effect
 [*]The game no longer crashes when a push block breaks glass or another breakable block
 [*]Fixed an issue where the game would crash when an item spawner was present
 [*]Fixed an issue where pausing the game would leave your inputs active in the adventure & battle menus
 [*]Fixed an error with inputs on the main menu that would crash the game
 [*]Enemies will no longer hover if you place them on the ground
 [*]Guns will no longer bounce infinitely
 [*]Health bars will no longer extend beyond a certain limit
 [*]Fixed an error with inputs on the main menu that would crash the game
 [*]Item spawners will actually work now

[/list]

Plenty of good fixes in this update, please keep reporting bugs through our official channels so we can get them fixed ASAP!

-Troy

notes.title: STICK ENGINE v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Engineers,

Hope you're enjoying the extensive tools of STICK ENGINE! As always, if you have any problems we appriciate you posting them in the bug reports section of our discord where we're able to see them!

[b]New in 1.0.1[/b]
[list]
    [*]You can now fullscreen from the pause menu
[/list]

[b]Fixes in 1.0.1[/b]
[list]
    [*]A rendering error with doors was fixed
 [*]The controller cursor in the main menu has been fixed, and should allow you to use all of the main menu with a controller.
[/list]

We'll be fixing known bugs before getting into some new features this weekend. Stay tuned for more info. 

-Troy
